subject: AcmeCloud procurement timeline & PO options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery — procurement path & next steps

Hi Jordan / Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path and timeline: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: AcmeCloud wants to embed a customer support summarization flow across internal tools and a public-facing help widget.
- Expected volume: ~200k tokens/day initially, potential to double in Q3.
- Security: need SOC2 evidence, VPC option for sensitive logs, and KMS integration.

Commercial / procurement options discussed:
1) Card for initial pilot (fastest) — credit card on file, month-to-month billing.
2) PO + invoice (preferred for enterprise finance teams) — Redwood accepts PO; typical lead time is 2–3 weeks for standard reviews.
3) Cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — longer procurement lead time but simplifies ongoing billing for some customers.

Immediate next steps:
- You: indicate preferred commercial path (card / PO / marketplace) — Jordan
- Redwood: prepare mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for legal, security review, finance PO issuance — Marissa
- CC: Loop in Sales Ops/legal if PO path chosen (I can introduce Aditya for contract questions) — Marissa

Proposed timeline if you choose PO:
- Week 0: Intro & return of PO template (you)
- Week 1: Legal review + initial security questionnaire exchange
- Week 2: Finance sign-off / PO issuance
- Week 3: Kickoff and onboarding

I'll draft a short MAP and send over the PO template (if helpful). Let me know if that timeline matches your expectations.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Mutual-Action-Plan-ACME-0042.xlsx (stub)

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — procurement path & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that recap is helpful. Quick answers on our side:

- Preferred commercial path: PO is our default for anything with a contract value > $10k/month, so likely PO. We could do card for a very short pilot but that will require internal approvals.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating AWS Marketplace for a consolidated billing approach, but that would likely add 4–6 weeks to procurement, so we'd prefer direct PO for faster time-to-value.

A few clarifying Qs:
1) Does Redwood have a standard Master Services Agreement / Order Form we can send to our legal team?
2) For security, our InfoSec team will want SOC2, data flow diagrams, and details on how logs are retained/segregated. Can you share the standard evidence bundle?
3) Who should we include from Redwood on the PO? Any specific billing contact / address?

If PO is the path, I can circulate your PO template to finance tomorrow. Will loop in procurement and legal.

—Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Director of Procurement, AcmeCloud
jordan.matthews@acmecloud.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: PO path & MAP — next steps and owners

Jordan — perfect, thanks for confirming. Looping in Aditya (Sales Ops / contracts) and Rachel (Customer Success) to keep the MAP moving. Below is a short mutual action plan with owners and milestone dates based on a PO path.

Mutual Action Plan (high level) — AcmeCloud / Redwood
- Day 0 (today): Redwood sends PO template + MAP.xlsx (Marissa) — DONE
- Day 1–3: Acme legal & procurement to review PO and provide any redlines (Jordan / Acme legal)
- Day 3–7: Redwood legal (Aditya) to review redlines and return updated Order Form / MSA references (Aditya)
- Day 7–14: Security evidence exchange: Acme to send security questions; Redwood to provide SOC2 report, data flow diagrams, retention policy (Rachel / Redwood security docs)
- Day 10–21: Acme finance to approve and issue PO (Jordan / Acme finance)
- Post-PO: Kickoff onboarding + environment setup (Rachel / Redwood success)

Owners / contacts:
- Redwood contracts & billing: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
- Redwood success & security liaison: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
- Acme procurement: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecloud.com>
- Acme technical lead (onboarding): Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>

Notes on typical timelines and redlines:
- Standard MSA + Order Form works for most customers; Aditya will flag any unusual clauses.
- If Acme needs a DPA or custom security addendum, please flag by Day 3 to avoid delays.

Aditya / Rachel — can you confirm you have the SOC2 pack and PO/billing details ready to send once Jordan's team shares redlines?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
